sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your data regarding our delivery performance and the increased demand forecast. As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. As our base prices are currently frozen, any price reduction must be supported by an adjustment in commercial terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €430.68 per unit, with a price of €430.68 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have verified the historical purchase order data you provided; however, our base prices remain frozen. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. We are pleased to accept your proposed 36-month contract term.

Our offer stands at a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. 

In order to reduce the price to €430.68 per unit, we must trade the payment terms to 60 days net. This alternative package requires a price of €430.68 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

decisions.tactician: o1 ties E0 for the lowest C, €3,944,814, and sits exactly at its health price, so it does not trigger the relationship charge. It uses a 24-month term, which matches our two-year horizon, rather than E0's 36 months, which runs past the horizon and commits us longer than we need. Payment terms are the lever it said it was open on, which suits its freeze on price reductions. The sheet is worth less to it than its own (-3.7 %), so a counter is likely rather than instant acceptance. That is acceptable at this opening stage. The 60 d and 45 d options cost us more, and the 12-month options cost far more.

decisions.tactician: E0 trades a 36-month term, which the supplier explicitly values ("contract length") but which costs us nothing extra here, for a small price step to €431.29. Its C of €3,951,615 is the lowest of all options, below the best standing sheet offer:70530-1 at €3,955,149. The sheet is only -0.2% to it on cash terms, and the longer term should more than offset that, so acceptance is likely; its recent pace means about 0 replies to reach this level. o1 has the same C but offers the supplier nothing for its concession. Pushing toward the health price of about €425 would breach the stated freeze and the 2% committee threshold and risk a stall. Accepting now would leave the gain on the table. a1 anchors the price to the €412.74 we paid on our last orders.

why.tactician: offer:70530-2 has the lowest C of the standing sheets (€3,955,149, against €3,968,074 for the 60-day variant and €4,246,314 at the opening quote). The supplier stalled at zero movement after our last message. No unheard arguments and no priced options remain, so E0 or a hold would likely gain nothing. More pressure also risks a final offer or walk-away, and a lower price would raise the relationship charge near its 8 % margin floor.
